title: Deepen radio, eSIM and related donor research with pinned primary sources and explicit Reddit coverage
acceptance: Pin and inspect QcomBaseband, lpac and Scion AVF donors with license boundaries and exact source references
Record actual Reddit/archive queries, returned threads and inaccessible/deleted content without claiming exhaustive coverage
Map Samsung-specific CPIF/SIPC/SIT, eUICC and iOS integration gaps to concrete implementation and verification steps
Keep public evidence minimal and exclude firmware, SDKs, keys, private subscriptions and phone operations
steps: Inspect primary donor files at recorded revisions
Cross-check selected Reddit claims against source and preserve access failures
Publish source-level decisions and follow-up acceptance gates
